blocks.text: Rayver Cruz and Julie Anne San Jose are set to walk down the aisle as the actress said yes to the actor’s marriage proposal after five years of being together. Rayver documented the intimate event from when he popped the question, through a video on his Instagram page on Monday, Nov. 23. Present at the marriage proposal were their family members including Rayver’s brother Rodjun Cruz and the latter’s wife, Dianne Medina, as well as fellow actors Miguel Tanfelix and his actress girlfriend Ysabel Ortega. “Gusto ko lang sabihin sa’yo sa na mahal na mahal kita at totoo ‘yung sinasabi ko […]...
